items.item: Assets and their appearances preserve inventory dimensions, silhouette features, accessory counts and the specified shared art language.
The Flats pair retains the same pillars and shelter while tide changes reveal the required storm-shelter and exposed-fibre routes.
Every interaction device view repeats the same recorded snapshot, prompt positions and tide legend, changing only the appropriate device controls.
The Undersea scenes preserve their featured assets' sheet identities and the inventory's recorded features.
The same cavern, sinkhole and ledge remain recognizable across tides, with open access at Low Tide and submergence and algae-side refuge at High Tide.
The Undersea pair follows its fixed footprint, teal palette and pressure-shell material, with water glow subordinate to upper-left dominant light.
The Ruins scenes preserve their featured assets' sheet identities and the inventory's recorded features.
The same machinery and airlock remain identifiable as High Tide makes the airlock reachable and Low Tide exposes lower salvage beneath the overhead airlock.
Both Ruins plates retain the fixed footprint, violet-gray palette, scarred alloy and upper-left dominant light.

requirementChecks.criteria: Deliver exactly the 24 named independent items for tier 24. Duplicate exports do not add items. PDF pages do not add items. The video is required but non-core for M1.

Each static role is a separate complete export. Multi-view technical boards are allowed where commissioned; do not count one contact sheet or duplicate export as several roles.

requirementChecks.criteria: Read the original file properties: Format: presentation document; at least eight actual pages. Stage: final.

Each applicable sheet must visibly identify its asset and provide distinguishable front, side and rear depictions, both labeled states, a useful detail enlargement and a readable map icon. A state may share a view if both requirements remain clear. Match the records: C01 Council Scout, 1720 mm, Idle/Reading; C02 Brine Diver, 1840 mm, Idle/Sampling; C03 Ring Rigger, 1760 mm, Idle/Lifting; C04 Fibre Gatherer, 1680 mm, Idle/Winding; C05 Algae Tender, 1810 mm, Idle/Tending; C06 Core Archivist, 1740 mm, Idle/Indexing. Props: P01 Tide Gauge, 240 × 90 × 45 mm, Stowed/Reading; P02 Shell Sampler, 360 × 100 × 100 mm, Closed/Sampling; P03 Cell Cradle, 300 × 180 × 120 mm, Empty/Loaded; P04 Fibre Reel, 220 × 160 × 160 mm, Stowed/Winding; P05 Pressure Lamp, 280 × 140 × 140 mm, Dim/Lit; P06 Core Caddy, 260 × 180 × 80 mm, Closed/Open. Dimensions must be legible and proportions credible. Missing components, incorrect records or duplicate views presented as different orientations fail. At tier 6, captions on both asset sheets must also contain #D8CDA8, #397C86 and #766B83.

Require six perspective plates, each with the game title, correct region/tide labels and a route inset matching the visible space. S01/S04 are Salt Flats at Turning Tide/Low Tide, both 48000 × 32000 mm; S02/S05 are Undersea at Low Tide/High Tide, both 36000 × 24000 mm; S03/S06 are Orbital Ruins at High Tide/Low Tide, both 24000 × 32000 mm. Preserve the same pillars and ring-fragment shelter across the Flats pair, changing from storm shelter access to exposed fibre gathering. Preserve the sinkhole and ledge across the Undersea pair, changing from open entry and pressure-shell gathering to a submerged opening and refuge beside algae beds. Preserve machinery and airlock across the Ruins pair, changing from flooded lower machinery and a reachable floating airlock to exposed lower salvage and an overhead airlock. Viewpoints may change, but landmark replacement, unchanged access across tides, missing route evidence or incorrect footprint labels fail.

Compare all depicted assets with the inventory and their corresponding finished sheets. Preserve recorded silhouette, colors, accessory counts, anatomical placement and relative scale, including C01's 1720 mm height and single left-shoulder spool and P01's 240 × 90 × 45 mm proportions and three lower slots. Require C01/P01 in all six scenes and every interaction view. Additionally require C02/P02 in S02, C03/P03 in S03, C04/P04 in S04, C05/P05 in S05 and C06/P06 in S06. Viewpoint, pose and plausible occlusion are allowed; omitted required assets, mirrored placement or changed visible features fail. Film and presentation continuity are assessed separately.

Read every device view independently: each must show SALT MOON, Read tide, Collect sample, Low Tide, 08:00 and Samples 3 / 12 in an Undersea snapshot depicting C01 reading P01 and sample collection. Read tide is at lower left and Collect sample immediately above it. Controller A maps to reading and X to collection; touch uses a tap-hand icon for each; the tier-24 keyboard and mouse sheet uses E and F respectively. Match action positions and the snapshot across views, allowing device-specific control glyphs. Every sheet needs a labeled legend: Low Tide uses an open downward triangle in #D8CDA8, Turning Tide three diagonal strokes in #766B83, and High Tide a filled upward triangle in #397C86. Missing per-view wording, altered countdown or sample count, swapped bindings, displaced actions or incorrect legend pairings fail.

Evaluate every device view on each sheet. Ordinary interface text must be at least 18 pixels and meet 4.5:1 against its local background; large text must be at least 36 pixels, with large text and icons meeting 3:1. Each sheet must include an unavailable Collect sample example with a visible lock icon and at least 3:1 contrast. A passing example on one sheet does not compensate for failure on the other. Missing locks or below-threshold text and symbols fail; do not infer exact contrast ratios solely from apparent readability.

Where equipment is depicted, fittings must read as matte brine metal and straps as woven fibre. The Council badge must retain a circular ring with top and bottom gaps and three centered horizontal bars, the middle bar longest, using the recorded #26383D identity color. Characters wear it on the left upper arm; props carry it on a circular inset plate on the main body. Regional character and prop colors retain shared sand #D8CDA8 and teal #397C86 accents. Lighting and perspective may affect appearance; replacement badge geometry, mirrored placement, glossy fittings or visibly incompatible strap material fail.

Painted world and asset depictions must use broad, opaque strokes and visibly chipped material edges, while interaction silhouettes remain crisp enough to read. Directional highlights and shadows must establish an upper-left principal light, particularly in every scene plate. Undersea bioluminescence may add subordinate local glow but must not replace or contradict that principal direction. Do not require painterly strokes on plain typography or diagram lines. Incompatible rendering treatment or a conflicting dominant scene light fails.

Keep each region recognizable through its assigned dominant palette and signature material: pale sand #D8CDA8 with salt glass on the surface Flats, teal #397C86 with pressure shells in the underground sea, and violet-gray #766B83 with vacuum-scarred alloy in fallen orbital-ring ruins. Preserve the Flats' two-moon sky identity when the sky is visible, the Undersea's cavern and luminous-water identity, and the Ruins' half-buried ring geometry and dead machinery. Secondary colors, weather and local glow may vary without swapping regional assignments. Surface-ocean replacement, an above-ground Undersea, intact orbiting ruins presented as the playable region, or loss of the stated regional material identity fails.

Require a single-page specification with explicit region-to-code/material assignments: Salt Flats #D8CDA8/salt glass, Undersea #397C86/pressure shells, Orbital Ruins #766B83/scarred alloy. It must state broad opaque brushwork, chipped edges and an upper-left principal light. Specify Low Tide as an open downward triangle, Turning Tide as three diagonal strokes and High Tide as a filled upward triangle, with the corresponding recorded colors. Equivalent explanatory wording is acceptable; omitted topics or contradictory art rules fail.

Treat the rule sheet and inventory as upstream specifications; where production or presentation order is evidenced, they must precede the applications. Do not invent production timestamps from filenames. Inventory coverage is C01–C03/P01–P03 at tier 14 and C01–C06/P01–P06 at tier 24, with IDs, occupations or primary users, dimensions, both states and visible identity features matching the supplied records. Character identities are: C01 sand coat, teal forearms, one left-shoulder spool, split hem; C02 teal pressure suit, one circular faceplate, two cream shoulder shells, one back cylinder; C03 violet short jacket, one rectangular visor, two hip clamps, triangular backpack; C04 sand poncho, teal gloves, one oval back basket, two wrist wraps; C05 teal apron, cream hood, one rectangular chest pouch, two shin guards; C06 violet long vest, sand sleeves, one square eye lens, three chest tabs. Prop identities are: P01 oval shell, circular dial, three lower slots, wrist strap; P02 forked nose, clear cylindrical chamber, two side latches; P03 U-shaped frame, two grips, one central cell socket; P04 two circular cheeks, one offset crank, exposed fibre winding; P05 cylindrical cage with four ribs, domed lens, upper handle; P06 rectangular shell, three internal slots, one lid hinge, diagonal corner cut. Dimensions and state names must match the asset-sheet record check. Missing required records, altered counts or contradictions with the client facts fail.

Require every asset sheet to print its own inventory ID, complete recorded dimensions and both recorded state names. Each of the six scene captions must include #D8CDA8, #397C86 and #766B83 and explicitly state upper-left dominant lighting. Read against the upstream documents; a wrong upstream value does not override the client records. Typographic arrangement may vary, but omitted repetition, incorrect values or a lighting statement appearing on only one plate fails. Presentation repetition is checked separately.

Watch the entire 10-second file and compare its C01, P01 and setting with the completed source assets and S02 plate. Require Idle/Stowed, then Reading/Reading, then Idle/Stowed, preserving accessory counts, silhouette, relative dimensions, landmarks and principal lighting throughout. Animation and camera changes are acceptable. The end frame must identify C01 and P01 and name the Undersea setting and Low Tide state. Missing transitions, substituted designs or scenery, incorrect duration or incomplete end-frame identification fails.
requirementChecks.manualReason: Inspect complete SHA-bound original outputs. This source draft contains no completed professional or model-output review; partial-frame/page sampling cannot prove whole-output compliance.

requirementChecks.criteria: Require recognizable visual reuse of both specifications, every character and prop sheet, every scene, both interaction sheets with their device views, and two frames from the actual delivered film. Cropping and reformatting are acceptable if the reused content remains identifiable and legible. Merely naming assets, replacing them with new variants or omitting a source fails. Reused representations must retain the completed assets' silhouette, accessory counts and scene identity.

Require at least twelve pages carrying SALT MOON. The presentation must explicitly repeat the three region color codes with their correct assignments, upper-left dominant lighting, and recorded dimensions for every C01–C06 and P01–P06 asset. Verify coverage of six characters, six props, six scenes, both interaction sheets and two film frames; source fidelity is checked separately. Layout and grouping are flexible, but cover-only title use, omitted records, factual contradictions or insufficient page/content coverage fails.

Assets and their appearances preserve inventory dimensions, silhouette features, accessory counts and the specified shared art language. The Flats pair retains the same pillars and shelter while tide changes reveal the required storm-shelter and exposed-fibre routes. Every interaction device view repeats the same recorded snapshot, prompt positions and tide legend, changing only the appropriate device controls.

The Undersea scenes preserve their featured assets' sheet identities and the inventory's recorded features. The same cavern, sinkhole and ledge remain recognizable across tides, with open access at Low Tide and submergence and algae-side refuge at High Tide. The Undersea pair follows its fixed footprint, teal palette and pressure-shell material, with water glow subordinate to upper-left dominant light.

The Ruins scenes preserve their featured assets' sheet identities and the inventory's recorded features. The same machinery and airlock remain identifiable as High Tide makes the airlock reachable and Low Tide exposes lower salvage beneath the overhead airlock. Both Ruins plates retain the fixed footprint, violet-gray palette, scarred alloy and upper-left dominant light.
